newsitem.title: POLAND: Warta sets February subscription period.
newsitem.headline: Warta sets February subscription period.

text.p: The Polish insurance company TUiR Warta SA will offer its new share issue for subscription from February 5 to February 28, the company said in a statement on Friday.

It earlier said the planned issue of between 865,380 and 2,596,139 shares priced at 48 zlotys would be offered to banks, with which it wanted to set up a banking-insurance group, and two minority shareholders.
The banks involved are Bank Przemyslowo Handlowy SA (BPH), Kredyt Bank SA and the Powszechny Bank Kredytowy SA (PBK). The issue still needs Polish Securities Commission approval.
